facts.business: Ramkrishna Forgings Limited is a manufacturer of forgings and machined components primarily for the commercial vehicle segment, with operations in India and exports to the USA.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Commercial vehicle industry volumes are expected to grow in the mid-single-digit range (4–6%) in FY 2026–27, led by the M&HCV segment.

auditor.name: S.R. BATLIBOI & CO. LLP and M/S. S.K. NAREDI & CO. LLP

key_risks: Foreign currency risk from USD and Euro denominated transactions and borrowings
Liquidity risk managed through committed credit lines and rolling forecasts
Market risk including interest rate risk and commodity price risk
Credit risk from trade receivables and bank balances
Cyclical downturn in US Class 8 truck market with 13-14% decline in retail sales
Extended weak freight demand and high costs in USA segment
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details disclosed in notes to standalone financial statements as per applicable accounting standards.
